description: Defines configuration structs and parameters for various scheduler policies and expert configurations in a 5G NR system, including QoS-aware scheduling, round-robin, power control, time advance, UE scheduling, system info, random access, and paging.

classes.name: time_qos_scheduler_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for QoS-aware scheduler policy, including sub-weight combination method, fairness coefficient, and QoS priorities.

classes.name: time_rr_scheduler_config
classes.description: Empty struct for round-robin scheduler configuration.

classes.name: scheduler_policy_config
classes.description: Variant type that can hold either QoS-aware or round-robin scheduler configuration.

classes.name: ul_power_control
classes.description: Configuration for uplink power control, including closed-loop control flags, target SINRs, and path loss parameters.

classes.name: scheduler_ta_control_config
classes.description: Parameters for Time Advance control loop, including measurement periods, thresholds, and outlier detection.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_expert_config
classes.description: UE scheduling parameters such as MCS ranges, HARQ retries, CQI, resource block limits, and power control.

classes.name: scheduler_si_expert_config
classes.description: System Information broadcast configuration including MCS indices and retransmission periods.

classes.name: scheduler_ra_expert_config
classes.description: Random access procedure parameters including MCS indices, retries, guardbands, and timeouts.

classes.name: scheduler_paging_expert_config
classes.description: Paging procedure parameters including MCS index, aggregation level, and retries.

classes.name: scheduler_expert_config
classes.description: Aggregated configuration for system info, random access, paging, UE, and broadcast message logging.
